move: chevrons ripple upward, finger swipes card deck up, deck steps forward
how: Over a slowly panning aurora background, two masked headline lines rise (expo.out, stagger 0.1), a subline fades up and three stacked cards (y -44i, scale 1-0.06i, filter brightness 1-0.25i) rise from +900 with expo.out (negative stagger so the back arrives first); a 'Swipe up' label fades in. Three chevrons ripple continuously: y 14→-14 with opacity 0.15→1 (power2.out, stagger -0.12) then to y -30 fading, every 0.8s for four cycles. A swipe() beat at 32% and 62%: a translucent finger ring fades in at the bottom, drags y 0→-420 with power3.inOut over 0.45s and fades out enlarged, while the front card flies to y -2000 with rotation -4 (power3.in 0.55s) and the cards behind step forward (y, scale, brightness with expo.out 0.6s). At 86% the last card flies off and all three return from y 1000 with move at 0.05s offsets, restoring the fresh deck.
adapt: Replace the background image, headline, subline, the three card thumbnails/titles and the label; keep the 0.8s chevron cycle, the 0.45s finger drag and the 0.55s card throw.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the background, header, prompt with chevrons, deck and finger with the initial pose sets; animate(el, shot, D) returns the timeline with swipes at 0.325D and 0.625D and the deck reset at 0.86D. Move swipe() inside animate with el-scoped selectors; from() tweens need immediateRender:false.
caveats: filter: brightness tweens on the back cards
